headline: Hotel101 Enters Indian Market With $64 Million Hotel Development Project
summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp., a Nasdaq-listed subsidiary of DoubleDragon Corp., is expanding into India by developing a 625-room hotel project.
why: Cross-border expansion projects reflect corporate growth strategies and capital deployment in emerging international hospitality markets.

impacts.name: DoubleDragon Corp
impacts.why: Capital expenditure for a new international hotel project directly impacts the parent company's investments.
